prerequisites: Complete the web foundations or know how to open the project, edit a file, and verify the result in a browser. No previous commercial experience is required.
objectives: Turn Audience, positioning, and channel choice into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

blocks.text: Choose a few channels based on customer behavior, sustainable format, objective, and response capacity instead of posting everywhere. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Audience, positioning, and channel choice is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Choose a few channels based on customer behavior, sustainable format, objective, and response capacity instead of posting everywhere. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Audience, positioning, and channel choice, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers a channel strategy with audience, promise, and cadence. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.

lessons.title: Influencers, affiliates, and measurable partnerships
prerequisites: Complete the web foundations or know how to open the project, edit a file, and verify the result in a browser. No previous commercial experience is required.
objectives: Turn Influencers, affiliates, and measurable partnerships into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.
Turn a partnership brief and profitability sheet into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

Turn Select by audience and credibility; contract deliverables, rights, disclosure, cost, and incremental measurement rather than follower count. into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

blocks.text: Select by audience and credibility; contract deliverables, rights, disclosure, cost, and incremental measurement rather than follower count. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Influencers, affiliates, and measurable partnerships is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Select by audience and credibility; contract deliverables, rights, disclosure, cost, and incremental measurement rather than follower count. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Influencers, affiliates, and measurable partnerships, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers a partnership brief and profitability sheet. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.
